sentences.text: This matter is taken up by hybrid mode.

02. 2. Heard Mr. S.D. Das, learned Senior Advocate along with Mr. H. Mohanty, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. P.K. Muduli, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State.
3.

The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking direction to the opposite parties to pay the compensation of the land and building in respect of the land appertaining to Khata No. 16/15, Plot No. 71/208, Ac. 0.020 dec, Mouza- Bhaurinpathara, Tahasil- Harabhanga to the Petitioner within a stipulated time and to declare the date of Preliminary Notification u/s 11 (1) of RFCTLAR & R Act,
2013 as 12.06.2020 is contrary to the provision of Sec 11 (1) of the said Act and to direct the opposite parties/State Government to consider the date of Preliminary Notification u/s 11(1) of the RFCTLAR & R Act, 2013 as 27.02.2022 i.e. the date on which the Land Acquisition notification was published in the daily news paper in Regional Language.

4. Mr. S.D. Das, learned Senior Advocate appearing for the petitioner contended that though under the valuation report communicated by the Superintending Engineer, Boudh (R&B) Division, Boudh on 04.03.2022 under Annexure-7, the name of the petitioner had been reflected, but in the final Notification his name has not been reflected, thereby the petitioner has been denied the benefit of getting compensation amount for acquisition of his land.

5. Mr. P.K. Muduli, learned Additional Government Advocate contended that if the petitioner's name has not been indicated in the final Notification, it is open to the petitioner to raise her objection before the Collector, Boudh, so that the same can be considered in accordance with law.

Similarly so far as declaration of date of preliminary notification as 27.02.2022 instead of 12.06.2020, the petitioner can very well raise such objection before the said authority, who can also Kirtichandra Behera vs State Of Odisha And Others ..... ... on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81909661/

6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, since the petitioner is claiming that her name was reflected under the valuation report communicated by the Superintending Engineer, Boudh (R&B) Division, Boudh on 04.03.2022 under Annexure-7, but the same was not reflected in the final notification and also raising the question with regard to date of preliminary notification contending that it should have been 27.02.2022 instead of 12.06.2020, it is open to the petitioner to raise all such objections before the Collector, Boudh within a period of fifteen days hence, so that the Collector, Boudh will consider the same and pass appropriate order in accordance with law.
7. With the above observation and direction, the writ petition stands disposed of.
